intro: Exploring the Horde is an introductory quest that sends adventurers on an expansive tour of Horde leadership. Initiated by reporting to Nazgrel in Grommash Hold, the journey tasks travelers with seeking audiences with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. It establishes the diplomatic and military ties that unite the orcs, trolls, tauren, and Forsaken.

p: Exploring the Horde begins at Grommash Hold, the fortress at the heart of Orgrimmar where Nazgrel and the Warchief's council oversee military operations. Adventurers are directed to Nazgrel to receive orders sending them outward into the wider territories held by the coalition. Rather than remaining confined to the red canyons of Durotar, the task requires traveling far to learn the true breadth of the peoples united under the red banner.

The quest sends travelers to speak with the primary voices governing the allied races: Shadow Hunter Vol'jin of the Darkspear trolls, High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof of the tauren, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, queen of the Forsaken. By meeting these figures face-to-face, an adventurer gains firsthand understanding of the bonds tying Kalimdor to the plague-scarred lands of Lordaeron across the Great Sea.
